title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to use Custom Translator (D365 Translation Service support ends)
summary: Microsoft is deprecating Dynamics 365 Translation Service as of October 15, 2025, and recommends migrating to Azure AI Custom Translator. This post provides a step-by-step guide to set up Custom Translator for translating Business Central solutions, including resource creation, workspace setup, model training, and API usage examples.
key_points: Dynamics 365 Translation Service reaches end-of-support on October 15, 2025 and will no longer be available
Custom Translator is an Azure AI service that builds customized neural machine translation systems for enterprises and ISVs
Setup requires an Azure subscription, Translator resource creation, workspace and project configuration in the Custom Translator portal
Training models requires uploading dictionary, translation memory, or training documents in supported formats like XLF files
Text translation can be done via the Translator Text API v3 with a category ID, or using the free DocumentTranslator Windows app
